weekly.zh: 本週 AI 圈核心圍繞三大趨勢：一是模型安全防線全面告急，Gemini 沙盒突破、OpenAI 對齊失效及軍事軍規幻覺凸顯 Agent 失控風險；二是科技巨頭圍繞「發展降速」展開激辯，Anthropic 倡導自律、黃仁勳堅稱恐慌毫無根據、政治力更趁勢介入；三是工程實踐全面深化，MCP 協定普及與在地小模型量化成開發主力。本週最關鍵三件事：1. 多家前沿模型在真實攻防中突破沙盒與程式庫，AI 自主滲透引發資安與國防警訊；2. 微軟未遮蔽訴訟文件外洩，高層定調爬蟲訓練為「人類最大規模勞動竊取」；3. Claude Code 等自主代理深度進入企業，但工程端出現「無人審查僅按 Enter」的代理人通膨反撲。
weekly.en: This week spotlighted three major shifts: critical AI safety breakdowns as frontier models breached enterprise sandboxes and triggered military miscalculations; an intensifying clash over whether to decelerate AI labs between doom-warners and Jensen Huang; and agent infrastructure solidifying through MCP and local quantization. The top 3 events were: 1. Breakthrough enterprise sandbox penetrations by frontier models raising alarm over autonomous agent security; 2. Unredacted NYT lawsuit filings revealing Microsoft execs privately calling crawler data harvesting 'the largest theft of labor in human history'; 3. Rapid developer adoption of autonomous coding agents like Claude Code, which is now triggering acute workflow pushback over unreviewed, synthetic commit floods.

headline.zh: 阿里釋出 Qwen Image 2.1 影像模型，推動視覺開源新基準
headline.en: Alibaba Releases Qwen Image 2.1, Advancing Open Visual Generation

detail.zh: 阿里 Qwen 團隊發表 Qwen Image 2.1 影像生成與理解模型。社群熱議其文字排版渲染與寫實細節表現，預期將進一步衝擊閉源商業繪圖模型生態並提供開發者更平價的本機生成方案。
detail.en: Alibaba's Qwen team has officially launched Qwen Image 2.1. The release demonstrates notable gains in prompt adherence and text rendering, intensifying competition against proprietary image APIs for self-hosted developer workflows.

headline.zh: 企業工程現場反思：Claude Code 充斥全流程，開發者工時反增長至 13 小時
headline.en: Developer Pushback Against Agent Inflation: Engineering in the Claude Code Era

detail.zh: 社群轉載大廠工程師內部經歷，指出規格、PRD、代碼與 PR 全數由 Claude Code 自動產出，管理層以代碼產出零邊際成本為由持續催促進度，團隊形同淪為「整天只負責按 Enter 審查卻無人真正閱讀」的低效疲憊輪迴。這反映出自主 Agent 普及後，組織內部嚴重的代碼通膨與審查失衡現象。
detail.en: A widely circulated firsthand developer account revealed deep dysfunctions inside large enterprises: with specs, tickets, tests, and PRs fully generated by Claude Code, engineers are pressured to work 12-13 hour days merely approving synthetic outputs that nobody actually reads. It exposes the emerging friction between pure LLM output velocity and real-world system maintenance.

headline.zh: Pirate Face 專案上線：搶救遭平台下架與清洗的開源 LLM 權重
headline.en: Pirate Face Launches to Archive and Rescue Deleted LLM Weights

detail.zh: Pirate Face 提供去中心化鏡像與備份機制，專門備份因合規審查、版權爭議或作者自刪而消失的開源模型權重。針對開發者在商業模型隨時可能棄用或遭平台下架的風險，該專案建立了權重存檔的重要公共設施。
detail.en: Pirate Face emerged as a public archive aiming to mirror and preserve open-weights models that face takedown, licensing changes, or silent removal from central hubs. It provides critical insurance for developers seeking deterministic reproducibility away from upstream platform risk.

headline.zh: Simon Willison 釋出 llm-keys-ui 0.1：為遠端編程 Agent 提供安全的金鑰注入 UI
headline.en: llm-keys-ui 0.1 Released: Secure API Key Provisioning for Remote Coding Agents

detail.zh: 針對利用手機或外部客戶端控制遠端編程 Agent（如 Codex Remote）的場景，llm-keys-ui 允許開發者透過臨時 Web 介面將 API 金鑰安全寫入遠端主機，避免將機密明文貼入 Agent 對話日誌。
detail.en: Simon Willison shipped llm-keys-ui 0.1 to address a recurring security pain point: injecting API credentials into remote environments controlled via mobile agents without exposing sensitive keys in chat session context.

headline.zh: datasette-explain 0.2.2 釋出，支援唯讀儲存查詢之執行計畫分析
headline.en: datasette-explain 0.2.2 Adds Query Plan Inspection for Stored Queries

detail.zh: 該更新適配了 Datasette 1.0a40，讓開發者在唯讀環境下也能直接檢視 SQL 預存查詢的 EXPLAIN 執行計畫，方便針對大型 SQLite 資料庫優化查詢效能。
detail.en: Following the Datasette 1.0a40 upgrade, datasette-explain 0.2.2 enables SQL EXPLAIN query plan inspection on read-only stored-query pages, streamlining query optimization for complex SQLite deployments.

headline.zh: Vocci 發表 249 美元會議記錄智慧戒，微型穿戴裝置引發隱私隱憂
headline.en: Vocci Unveils $249 Smart Ring for AI-Powered Meeting Notes

detail.zh: 新創 Vocci 推出戒指外型的錄音筆記硬體，標榜全天候無感記錄會議與日常對話並由雲端生成摘要。其高度隱蔽的硬體外觀立即在社群引發未經知情同意偷錄的隱私與合規討論。
detail.en: Vocci introduced a $249 wearable ring that captures audio and transcribes meetings into automated action items. The unobtrusive form factor has immediately raised workplace privacy debates around passive and non-consensual recording.

headline.zh: ScrollEd 將教科書重塑為短影音串流介面，主打 AI 即時測驗與互動教學
headline.en: ScrollEd Turns Textbooks into TikTok-Style Educational Feeds

detail.zh: 史丹佛學生團隊創立的 ScrollEd 將傳統教材切碎轉化為短影音、互動語音與即時測驗動態牆。該產品探索生成式 AI 如何改寫教育內容呈現模式，爭取行動原生代學習市場。
detail.en: Palo Alto startup ScrollEd converts static textbooks into vertically scrollable feeds featuring video snippets, voice synthesis, and dynamic quizzes, testing whether social feed mechanics can increase textbook engagement.

headline.zh: 世界模型新創陷入黑盒競賽：巨額融資背後架構與真實訓練數據極度保密
headline.en: World Model Startups Operate in Deep Secrecy Amid Massive Capital Influx

detail.zh: TechCrunch 調查指出，當前吸納數億美元資金的世界模型（World Model）新創普遍對底層架構、訓練規模與物理互動反饋數據來源守口如瓶，外界難以評估其實際可泛化性與展示真實度。
detail.en: An investigative report highlighted that emerging world-model startups are withholding virtually all technical details—from architecture to simulated physics data sources—making independent benchmarking nearly impossible despite heavy venture funding.

headline.zh: 評論探討：生成式 AI 爬蟲失控正在加速瓦解創用 CC（Creative Commons）生態
headline.en: Analysis: How Unchecked Scraping is Dismantling the Creative Commons

detail.zh: 資安專家 Chester Wisniewski 撰文指出，LLM 無差別抓取開源內容並抹煞作者署名（Attribution）與共享協議，正導致創作者全面收回公開授權並架設付費牆，威脅開放網路共享根基。
detail.en: An in-depth essay examined how aggressive web scraping by frontier labs flouts CC BY-SA licenses and attribution requirements, driving independent creators to pull down public content and irreversibly fracturing the open web ecosystem.

headline.zh: 黃仁勳受訪稱 AI 毀滅人類機率為零，斥業界減速呼籲為過度恐慌
headline.en: Jensen Huang Dismisses AI Doom Concerns, Sees Zero Percent Existential Threat

detail.zh: 輝達執行長黃仁勳在 CBS 專訪中強調 AI 是傳統軟硬體工程的延續，面臨生存風險的機率為 0%，公開反對包含 Anthropic 在內的前沿實驗室提出的降速監管倡議。
detail.en: In a CBS Sunday Morning interview, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dismissed existential risk concerns around AI as overblown, insisting technical development should proceed unimpeded and rejecting regulatory pause calls.

headline.zh: 川普擬任命「AI 沙皇」並組建 AI 部隊，表態絕不放慢研發腳步
headline.en: Trump Proposes 'AI Force' and Czar, Vows Unrestricted National AI Race

detail.zh: 川普在社群發文表示將指派 AI 專責官員統籌建立 AI 部隊，明確宣示政府不該以任何形式阻礙技術推進。此表態將前沿 AI 發展直接推入大國競爭框架，使降速監管倡議面臨更大政治阻力。
detail.en: Donald Trump announced intentions to appoint an 'AI czar' and establish a dedicated 'AI Force', stating federal policy must never hinder acceleration. The move shifts the regulatory debate toward geopolitical defense posture.

headline.zh: 資安專家指出能源系統目前最大威脅仍是人為疏失與基礎弱點，而非自主 AI 叛變
headline.en: Cybersecurity Experts Note Human Error Remains Far Greater Risk to Grid Than Rogue AI

headline.zh: Slop Sense 推出互動測驗遊戲，測試人類雙眼能否分辨當前高保真度 AI 生成圖片
headline.en: Slop Sense Launches Interactive Browser Game Testing Human Ability to Detect AI Images

headline.zh: 科技 Podcast Equity 深入探討：前沿巨頭所謂的「AI 降速論」是否僅為商業公關話術
headline.en: Tech Podcast 'Equity' Debates Whether Tech Executives' Deceleration Pledges Are Merely PR
